preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10, inclusive.
The number of different types of ingredients is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The quantity of each ingredient is between 1 and 10^4, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output is -1 if it is impossible to pick items in such a way that each type is picked at least twice, otherwise the output is at least 4.
If there is only one type of ingredient, the output is 2.

postconditions.expression: all(A_i >= 2 for A_i in A) implies output >= sum(A)
postconditions.description: If each type of ingredient has at least two units, the output is at least the sum of all quantities.
